status: DECISION RECORD (W2 AREA, D-AREA), MODEL ESTIMATE: every area number is a courtyard sum computed by pcb/partition_budget.py into pcb/partition-budget.json; no placement, no proof-fit; hardware gates stay OPEN

decision.summary: Four main boards: PWR-A (plate-bonded L, 7910 mm2), PWR-B (mezzanine on the PWR-A footprint, Samtec QSH/QTH-060-01 5.00 mm stack), RF (unchanged) and a two-sided CTRL; harness headers consolidated per destination and exit zone. Working partition (a): the draft PWR-B list, with the LNB OVP comparator (U220 group) kept on PWR-A next to U212 so that E1_SW and the LNB LDO rail do not cross. Computed verdict (MODEL ESTIMATE): no evaluated partition fits at 1.8. Candidate (a) gives PWR-A 0.640 and PWR-B 0.427 (usable / demand), because every PWR-A part taller than hA and every PWR-A power header costs PWR-B a window or an edge strip (3.8k + 1.4k of the 7.6k outline). CTRL two-sided gives top 1.003 and bottom 0.979 by area, and five CTRL bottom headers have no height-valid variant under the depth cap (ctrl_headers_unresolved), so CTRL is NOT FIT as well.
decision.why_a: (a) and (b) leave almost the same total shortfall (about 7.3k mm2 at 1.8), but (a) needs 53 B2B contacts against 81, moves no fused high-current internal net (E2_J21_FUSED) across the boards, and keeps the J21/display/Lime/AUX12 eFuses with their fuse holders and bulk capacitors; moving more groups to PWR-B overfills PWR-B, whose usable area is set by the windows
decision.shortfall_note: demand at 1.8 minus usable area, candidate (a), pcb/partition-budget.json; the PWR harness headers alone are 2.7k mm2 raw (about 4.9k at 1.8), two thirds of the PWR shortfall
decision.ctrl_headers_unresolved_note: CTRL bottom headers without a height-valid variant (ctrl.bottom_header_rule): X02P1-CTRL (LAB5 into CTRL), X25P1-CTRL (VCC_5V_PERI) and X28P1-CTRL (blower) are vertical Micro-Fit 43650, 9.9 + 1.0 - 3.9 = 7.0 > cap 6.0, and the right-angle variant has no read height and courtyard on this branch; X01I1-CTRL (S01 IDC 2 x 20 to the Q6A) and X27F1-CTRL (KK fan header) have no read height. Their area stays counted on the CTRL bottom (S01 and the LAB5 input cannot move to PWR by function); GR-3 gives them a lower connector within its read rating or MECH-3 a CTRL rear zone with free height, and candidate (am) shows the cost of moving them to PWR-A
rejected: (b) switch groups on PWR-B: PWR-A 0.701, PWR-B 0.364, 81 contacts and E2_J21_FUSED (4 A) across the boards

(c) Pololu modules off PWR-A on plate standoffs: PWR-A 0.721, PWR-B 0.701, still short, and no plate location exists (front face full, build/15 'Розмір'; behind the left leg sit the HF+ can and the RF bay, mechanical/generated/fit-report.md layout); a cut-out in the L for them saves nothing
bigger single PWR board or larger face: the face is fixed by the plan (D-ENV width unchanged, STACK.md:109 HMI layouts); depth growth adds no area
radials or headers on the RF board: RF max height 5.5 (mechanical/params/boards.json:91) and constraints DC-02/RF-01 (pcb/generated/constraints.json:37-77)
(h8) hB 8.0 instead of 5.5: PWR-A 0.650, PWR-B 0.491 for 2.5 mm more depth (dz_mezz 4.6); still short, and the radials (11.0-11.5 mm) stay above it

(s8) the 8.00 mm stack (QTH-060-02 with QSH-060-01, hA 7.5, window ceiling 15.1 mm): PWR-B 0.427 -> 0.560 (windows 3.8k -> 3.1k mm2: the polymer capacitors, XAL6060, SRR1260 and C506 no longer need one; the Keystone 3568 holders keep theirs, their height being a lower bound), PWR-A unchanged 0.640, dz_mezz 5.1 <= cap 6.0. It is the strongest PWR-B lever but is not adopted alone: PWR-B stays short, it costs 3 mm more depth, and the QTH-060-02-L-D-A terminal was 0 in stock on 2026-11-07 (the -K variant 33, -TR 5); it goes into next_decision together with a PWR-A lever (s8c)

(a60) the 60-contact QSH-030/QTH-030 pair: PWR-A 0.656, PWR-B 0.450 (288 and 274 mm2 less demand at 1.8), but the 53 contacts of (a) with the 20 % spare need 64 > 60 (b2b.spare_rule), and (b) needs 81

(am) the five unresolved CTRL bottom headers moved to PWR-A (rule_gr3: the function moves to PWR): PWR-A 0.566, PWR-B 0.245 (their edge strips), CTRL top 1.218, bottom 1.460; S01 (IDC to the Q6A) and the LAB5 input of CTRL cannot move by function, so their area stays on CTRL
decision.next_decision: OPEN for INT/owner (integration_plan step 8, F2): the PWR function needs about 7.3k mm2 more board area at 1.8 than PWR-A + PWR-B give in the plan's face, or a smaller PWR connector/circuit set. Best combinations evaluated (MODEL ESTIMATE): s8c (8.00 mm stack + Pololu modules off PWR-A + PCB-REAR) PWR-A 0.755, PWR-B 1.012; w2 (hypothetical radials <= hB + (b) + Pololu off) PWR-A 0.874. PWR-A stays short in every one (about 2.5k mm2 at best, s8c), so the owner lever is PWR-A area (a larger or second rear board, or face growth) or fewer PWR-A parts and headers; the 8.00 mm stack (s8, dz_mezz 5.1) is the PWR-B lever to take with it. GR-3, MECH-3 and the board packages implement (a) as the working partition; the real placement fill of PCB-PWRA-1/2 and PCB-PWRB is the trigger record.

header_orientation.rule_gr3: no vertical Molex 43650 on CTRL or RF (9.9 mm, LCSC C293740/C293547 read 2026-11-07, against the 5.5 mm CTRL/RF limit). CTRL: every harness header on the CTRL bottom, soldered from the top (pin field + 1.0 mm iron access lost on the top side), in the first variant of ctrl.bottom_header_rule whose read height h gives h + 1.0 - 3.9 <= the dz cap 6.0 over BMS/IP2368 (side entry PH 4.8 and PHD 5.0 do; a right-angle Micro-Fit qualifies once its height and courtyard are read; no header over the Lime band, 1.4 mm + dz). A header with no such variant is listed in pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.ctrl.headers_unresolved: GR-3 gives it a lower connector within its read rating, or MECH-3 a CTRL rear zone with free height >= h + 1.0, or its function moves to PWR (candidate 'am' counts that). PWR-B: side entry PH/PHD (hB 5.5). PWR-A: Micro-Fit, Mini-Fit Jr. and the battery-sense PH headers in uncovered edge strips.

The 120-contact pair costs area on two boards that are already short: 288 mm2 of PWR-A and 274 mm2 of PWR-B demand at 1.8 against the 60-contact pair (candidate a60: PWR-A 0.656, PWR-B 0.450 instead of 0.640 / 0.427). Stock (QSH-060 270, QTH-060 314, QSH-030 72, QTH-030 713, JLCPCB search 2026-11-07) is evidence only: either size is enough for one build. b2b.rule: contacts per crossing power net = ceil(I_protection / b2b_i_pin_A), I_protection from tools/assembly_data.py NET_CURRENT or net_current_extra; every other crossing net 1 contact; plus gnd_pins_per_power_net; Kelvin and precision nets (shunt nets, INA inputs, precision divider mid-points) never cross except declared_sense_pairs and sense_taps; GR-3 writes pcb/generated/b2b-nets.json by the same rule

bottom_header_rule.rule: a CTRL bottom header takes the first variant that has a courtyard formula and a read height h (h_mated if given) with h + clearance_mm - gap_mm <= envelope.cap.dz_max; dz_ctrl = the largest such term of the placed headers. A header with no such variant keeps its base courtyard on the CTRL bottom, is listed in ctrl.headers_unresolved, and the CTRL verdict is NOT FIT until it is resolved (rule_gr3)

height_rule.rule: a PWR part goes to PWR-B only if its schematic group is in partition.PWR_B_groups and its read or class height (heights) is <= hB; otherwise it stays on PWR-A (DOMAIN_OVERRIDE). Every PWR-A part taller than hA gets a window in PWR-B (courtyard + window_margin each side); inside a window a PWR-A part may reach stack + board_t + hB = 12.1 mm
height_rule.pwr_b_header_rule: a PWR-B header takes the first family variant whose mated height is <= hB (side entry at hB 5.5); PWR-A headers sit in uncovered edge strips (courtyard + margin), because every one of them is taller than hA
height_rule.finding: at 72ee71b 17 THT radials with read heights (EEU-FR1H470 x15 11.2 mm, UHE1E221MPD C207 11.5 mm, EEU-FR1C101 C511 11.0 mm; LCSC via the JLCPCB search, read 2026-11-07) already exceed the PWR max_height 9.0 of mechanical/params/boards.json:28; the 18th radial C512 (EEU-FR1C221) has no read height (class 7.0 from the KiCad footprint, TBD). Read PWR-A harness headers exceed it too: Micro-Fit 3.0 vertical 43650 9.9 mm (LCSC C293740/C293547; X02P1, X04P1, X11P1, X12P1, X19P1 and X32P1-PWR; the dual-row SL2-PWR-MF at 9.9 is an assumption) and Mini-Fit Jr. 5566 39288020 12.8 mm (LCSC C490534; X05J1, X10J1 and S06-07-PWR). Under this rule the radials stay on PWR-A inside PWR-B windows (ceiling 12.1 mm) and the headers sit in uncovered edge strips; MECH-3 gives both their height zones
